title: Missions: goals that pay CLOUT
description: A list of goals per character and per map (reach DeFi Summer on Market Eras, survive 10:00 as the Whale) that pay CLOUT once, with progress on the title screen and a toast when one lands.

title: Boss Rush: every boss, back to back
description: A new mode next to free play and the Daily: the bosses of all four maps one after another with a short breather between, and a boss-kill count on the game-over screen.

title: Play as The Miner
description: A fourth character, unlocked in the Market: a hard-hat bear-hunter whose pickaxe cracks shields, built for the grizzlies that end a quarter of all runs.
